Here are verified music activities for under-5s on Mondays that are free in Wakefield:

Moo Music Wakefield runs Mondays at Scout HQ behind Crigglestone Nursery School (WF4 3EB) with sessions at 9:30–10:15am (Mini Moo), 10:45–11:30am (Mini Moo), and 12:00–12:45pm (Baby Moo). 
Moo Music is an interactive music and sensory session for babies up to 4 years, with Baby Moo suitable for newborns to walkers and Mini Moo for toddlers up to 4 years old.

Stay and Play Alverthorpe runs Mondays 9:15–10:45am (term time), free with no booking needed, at Phoenix Centre, Flanshaw Lane, Alverthorpe, WF2 0AJ. This is a general playgroup rather than music-focused, but includes activities for under-5s.

Mini Maestros at Pontefract (Shake, Rattle and Roll, 10 South Bailey Gate Industrial Estate, Pontefract WF8 2LN) entertains 0–5 year olds with percussion, songs and nursery rhymes. Contact Helen on 07940 250251 to confirm current Monday availability and pricing.

Moo Music is your strongest verified match for free music activity on Mondays for under-5s.
